description: Contains configuration options for hosts (execution hosts but also a global configuration for the sge_qmaster).
Host specific configurations inherit values from the global configuration.
@todo there is an overlap with the exec host type (EH_Type), can this be unified?

attributes.name: name
description: Name of the host the configuration object refers to, or global for the global configuration.

attributes.name: version
description: Each configuration object has a version number which is increased with every change.

attributes.name: entries
description: A configuration consists of multiple configuration entries of CF_Type.
